hazards.control: Bleed the tubing and casing to zero and verify before breaking any connection.

name: Traveling valve
function: The ball and seat in a cage at the bottom of the plunger: closed on the upstroke to lift the fluid, open on the downstroke.

tabs.overview: Ball and seat in hard alloys; the cage guides the ball.
tabs.safety: A leaking traveling valve shows on the dynamometer card.
tabs.evidence: PetroWiki sucker-rod lift, ESP, and gas lift pages (S39, S40, S41); API 11AX, 11E, 11S, 11V (S43 to S46); field practice (S9). Generic geometry; not an OEM design.
